description: Create a proactive monitoring subscription to a live-data event stream. Returns the new subscription id. Requires a Pipeworx OAuth account (anonymous + BYO cannot persist subscriptions). Supported types: "sec_8k" (8-K filings matching ticker + item codes — e.g. items:["5.02"] = officer change), "polymarket_edge" (Polymarket↔Kalshi cross-venue mispricings — params:{topic:"fed"}), "fred_series" (new FRED observations — params:{series_id:"UNRATE"}), "patent_grant" (new USPTO grants for an applicant), "clinical_trial" (new/updated ClinicalTrials.gov studies), "form_d" (new SEC Form D fundraise notices — params:{state?, industry?, min_amount?, exemption?}, all optional), "news_keyword" (GDELT keyword news alerts, metadata+link only — params:{query, lang?, domains?}), "job_post" (new public job-board postings — params:{ats?, board_token?} or {domain?}, plus optional title_query/location_query), "tool_diff" (re-runs any read-only tool on a schedule and fires on change — params:{tool, args?, fields[], schedule}), "new_entity" (new business registrations from a state business-entity registry — params:{state:"CO", name_query?, entity_type?}), "tech_change" (a watched domain's website technology stack adds or drops a technology — params:{domains:["acme.com"], technologies?}). Delivery channels: feed (always on — pull via recent_alerts or GET registry.pipeworx.io/alerts.json), and optionally email (set delivery:{email:"you@x.com"}) or sms (delivery:{sms:"+15551234567"} — phone must be verified at /account first; 10/day cap).

delivery.description: Optional delivery channels in addition to the always-on persistent feed. {email:"you@x.com"} sends a templated alert per fired event. {sms:"+15551234567"} sends an SMS per event — must match the verified phone on the caller's account (verify at https://pipeworx.io/account first; 10/day cap). {webhook:"https://..."} POSTs each event JSON to your endpoint, HMAC-signed — the response includes delivery.webhook_secret (whsec_…) ONCE; verify X-Pipeworx-Signature = sha256 HMAC of "<X-Pipeworx-Timestamp>.<raw body>". Auto-disabled after 10 consecutive failing runs.

email.description: Email address to deliver alerts to. Validated against a standard pattern.

sms.description: E.164 phone number, e.g. "+15551234567". Must match the account's verified phone.

webhook.description: HTTPS URL to POST fired events to. https only; localhost/private hosts rejected. Signing secret returned once at subscribe time.

params.description: Type-specific filter. sec_8k: {ticker:"AAPL", items?:["5.02","1.01"]}. polymarket_edge: {topic:"fed", min_spread_bps?:500}. fred_series: {series_id:"UNRATE"}. patent_grant: {applicant:"Apple Inc."}. clinical_trial: {sponsor?:"Pfizer", condition?:"lung cancer", phase?:"PHASE3"} (sponsor or condition required). form_d: {state?:"CA", industry?:"Biotechnology", min_amount?:500000, exemption?:"06B"} (all optional — omit all to watch every new Form D nationwide). news_keyword: {query:"\"semiconductor sanctions\"", lang?:"eng", domains?:["reuters.com"]} (query required). job_post: EITHER {ats:"greenhouse", board_token:"acme"} (exact board) OR {domain:"acme.com"} (auto-detected), plus optional title_query/location_query substrings. tool_diff: {tool:"form5500", args?:{...}, fields:["headcount"], schedule:"daily"} — re-runs that tool on schedule and fires when the named fields change; tool must be read-only and not need a Pipeworx-held platform key; schedule "hourly" needs the paid tier. new_entity: {state:"CO", name_query?:"dental", entity_type?:"limited liability"} — state is required and must be one of FL, NY, CO, OR, CT, TX, PA. tech_change: {domains:["acme.com","example.org"], technologies?:["Shopify","Segment"]} — domains required (1-200), technologies optional (exact names, case-insensitive) to narrow which detected technologies alert. Unknown keys in form_d/news_keyword/job_post/tool_diff/new_entity/tech_change params are rejected at subscribe time.
